caption: The drawing features a single object, a metal coffee pot or kettle, centered on a plain, light beige background. The pot has a tall, cylindrical upper section with a domed lid topped by a small round knob. The lower section is wider and conical, tapering downward. It has a long, curved spout extending from the lower part and a large, curving handle attached to both the upper and lower sections. The color of the pot is predominantly a reddish-brown, with variations of copper and some greenish-yellow patina marks visible, giving it an aged appearance. The pot casts no visible shadow, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements. The composition is simple, with the pot positioned upright and all prominent features clearly delineated.
title: Coffee Pot
